title: Palak Paneer Spinach Cottage Cheese

seo.title: Authentic Palak Paneer: Spinach Cottage Cheese Curry
seo.metaDescription: Master the art of authentic Indian Palak Paneer! This easy recipe features fresh spinach and soft cottage cheese in a rich, flavorful curry. Perfect for a vegetarian meal.

seo.imageAlt: A vibrant bowl of authentic Palak Paneer, a creamy Indian spinach and cottage cheese curry, garnished.
seo.imageCaption: Enjoy this classic Indian Palak Paneer, a healthy and delicious vegetarian dish featuring fresh spinach and soft paneer.

description: Palak Paneer is a beloved Indian vegetarian dish featuring tender paneer cubes simmered in a vibrant, spiced spinach gravy. This creamy and nutritious curry offers a delightful blend of earthy spinach and mild cottage cheese, creating a wholesome and satisfying meal. It is a staple in Indian homes, perfect for a comforting dinner with naan or rice.

instructions.title: Blanch the Spinach
instructions.text: Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Add the washed spinach and blanch for 1-2 minutes until wilted. Immediately transfer the spinach to an ice bath to retain its vibrant green color. Once cooled, drain well and blend into a smooth puree with a splash of water if needed. Set aside.

instructions.title: Prepare the Paneer
instructions.text: Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee or oil in a pan over medium heat. Gently fry the paneer cubes until lightly golden on all sides. This adds a nice texture and prevents them from breaking. Remove and set aside. If you prefer softer paneer, you can skip frying and add it directly.

instructions.title: Sauté Aromatics
instructions.text: In the same pan, add the remaining ghee or oil. Once hot, add cumin seeds and let them splutter. Add the finely chopped onion and sauté until it turns golden brown, about 5-7 minutes. Add ginger garlic paste and green chili, cooking for another minute until fragrant.

instructions.title: Cook the Masala Base
instructions.text: Add the tomato puree to the pan and cook until the oil starts to separate from the mixture, stirring occasionally. This indicates the tomatoes are well cooked. Stir in turmeric powder, coriander powder, and red chili powder. Cook for 1-2 minutes, adding a tablespoon of water if the masala starts to stick.

instructions.title: Combine with Spinach Puree
instructions.text: Pour the spinach puree into the cooked masala. Mix well and add about 1/2 cup of water to adjust the consistency to your liking. Bring the curry to a gentle simmer, cooking for 5-7 minutes to allow the flavors to meld. Season with salt to taste.

instructions.title: Finish and Serve
instructions.text: Add the fried paneer cubes to the simmering spinach curry. Stir in garam masala and crushed Kasuri Methi. If using, gently fold in the fresh cream for a richer, creamier texture. Cook for another 2-3 minutes until heated through. Serve hot with naan, roti, or rice.

tips: To prevent spinach from losing its vibrant green color, always blanch it briefly and immediately plunge into ice-cold water.
For extra creamy Palak Paneer, you can add a tablespoon of cashew paste or almond paste along with the spinach puree.
If you prefer to avoid frying paneer, you can simply soak it in warm water for 10-15 minutes before adding to the curry to keep it soft.
